name: goldenhour
description: GoldenHour - Severity Ranking and Hospital Readiness Matching System for Emergency Ambulance Response

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
